reviewer: Codex — direct visual comparison of all 47 drawing/photo pairs on 12 comparison sheets
method: Original/canonical drawing compared with current photo derivative; distinct shapes and composition recorded below. This is not a historical-subject, church-location, or segmentation review.

Lion sits at lower left, elephant trunk curls at right, and a small monkey hangs from a branch above.

Bird flies toward a small window with a face; diagonal rays above and many wave bands below match.
